source.updated_files: diagnostic only; never silently replace a consumed original
source.semantics: FINRA TRF/ADF off-exchange publicly disseminated activity; not exchange-consolidated shorting and not short interest
source.facility_scope: Consolidated TRF/ADF NMS file; retain facility-level raw rows for diagnostics but primary feature is date+symbol aggregate.

feature.short_exempt: diagnostic only; ShortVolume already includes exempt
feature.aggregation: For each date+canonical symbol, sum ShortVolume, ShortExemptVolume and TotalVolume across all rows/facilities in the Consolidated NMS file, then compute ShortVolume_sum / TotalVolume_sum. Never average facility-level ratios.
feature.alias_order: Map PIT alias FB->META before date+symbol aggregation.

portfolio.construction: sector-balanced long bottom quintile / short top quintile
portfolio.cost: 10bp one-way applied to sum(abs(delta_weight)); no separate hidden roundtrip multiplier
portfolio.construction_detail: On each decision date after 20-session per-symbol warmup, rank all eligible panel symbols by z-score; choose deterministic bottom ceil(20%*N) long and top ceil(20%*N) short using z-score then symbol as tie-break. Within each side, assign equal gross weight to each represented sector, then equal weight to selected symbols within that sector. Scale long and short sides to 0.5 gross each, for 1.0 total gross and approximately zero net. Do not force a sector into a tail when no member naturally qualifies.
portfolio.sector_labels_asof: Frozen research labels above; no post-result relabeling.

overlap_5d: report overlapping and non-overlapping stride-5 sensitivity; primary portfolio accounting must not double-allocate capital
missing_policy: attempt every weekday in development window; 404/non-200 recorded in manifest; never impute FINRA rows; warmup requires 20 observed symbol sessions
ties: stable symbol sort after ratio/z-score; quintile membership deterministic

return_data.provenance: persist normalized OHLCV extract hash and retrieval timestamp
return_data.missing_policy: no OHLC forward fill; report missing symbol/session coverage
